_note: Categories for the Visual Effects column: real-time effects (mostly Unity VFX Graph / shaders) that translate easily to AR. Each VFX work has one `vfx_cat`; `code_url` links its source code.

categories.desc_en: Thousands of points that flow, flock, burst or trail.
categories.desc_zh: 成千上万的点在流动、聚集、迸发或拖尾。

categories.desc_en: Depth cameras, LiDAR and volumetric video turned into living 3D material.
categories.desc_zh: 把深度相机、LiDAR 和体积视频变成会动的三维材料。

categories.desc_en: Effects driven by segmentation, pose, hands or face tracking.
categories.desc_zh: 由人像分割、姿态、手部或面部追踪驱动的特效。

categories.desc_en: Visuals that listen: sound and music shape the effect.
categories.desc_zh: 会“听”的画面：声音和音乐决定特效的形态。

categories.desc_en: Geometry that grows, extrudes, tiles or deforms by rules.
categories.desc_zh: 按规则生长、挤出、平铺或变形的几何体。

categories.desc_en: Dissolves, holograms, glitches and materials that change what a surface looks like.
categories.desc_zh: 溶解、全息、故障和各种材质：改变一个表面看起来的样子。

categories.desc_en: Shapes defined by distance fields: smooth blends, infinite detail, impossible spaces.
categories.desc_zh: 用距离场定义形状：平滑融合、无限细节、不可能的空间。

categories.desc_en: Simulated fluid, smoke, cloth and soft bodies.
categories.desc_zh: 模拟的流体、烟雾、布料和软体。

categories.desc_en: Post-processing on the camera image: datamosh, slit-scan, feedback, stylisation.
categories.desc_zh: 对相机画面做后期：数据损坏、狭缝扫描、反馈、风格化。

categories.desc_en: Neural networks running in the engine: segmentation, style transfer, generative models.
categories.desc_zh: 在引擎里实时运行的神经网络：分割、风格迁移、生成模型。
